findings.summary: The dependents list leaves out a test that parses the real docs/spec.toml and checks every active measure, OLY-A-12 included
findings.evidence: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs:4285-4294 `the_real_spec_records_every_field_and_classes_the_acceleration_requirements_as_speed` does `parse_spec(include_str!("../../../docs/spec.toml"))` and asserts `measure_problem(&r.measure) == None` and a non-empty mechanism for every active requirement. That means it reads the changed OLY-A-12 text directly. The plan names `measure_problem` (hestia.rs ~1218-1231) and says 'A grep for OLY-A-12 in crates and xtask found no test that reads it'. This test reads all active requirements, so a grep for the id cannot find it. Step 7's by-name runs (`--lib reading`, `--test refusal_corpus`, xtask spec) do not run it; only the blanket `cargo test --locked` does. Other include_str! readers of CHANGELOG.md are also missing from the list: refusal_corpus.rs:1138/1148, 2986, 3033, 3073, 3128, 3187; reading.rs:4259, 4981, 6851, 7154, 7493; and crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs:2885. These are positive `contains` checks, or the same '3 of the 3 cited jobs' negative already handled, so a new bullet should not break them. Fix: Add hestia.rs:4285-4294 to dependents, with test `cargo test -p athena-core --lib the_real_spec_records_every_field`, and run it by name in step 7. Note that a measure ending `status: not shown` passes `measure_problem` because the label starts with `not shown`. Either list the other CHANGELOG readers above or state that every include_str!/read_to_string reader of CHANGELOG.md was grepped and all are positive `contains` checks covered by `cargo test --locked`.
findings.location: Plan, Dependents (the 'measure label `status: not shown`' entry) and Step 7

findings.summary: Criterion 1's 'fails without the behavior' claim is wrong: the xtask spec test passes when the mechanism is `none`
findings.evidence: xtask/tests/spec.rs:194-213 `check_how_it_is_met` only rejects an empty mechanism, and :627-644 counts `none` as complete (`!r.mechanism.trim().is_empty()`); the comment at :645 says `none` 'is a recorded answer, not a gap'. The current OLY-A-12 (spec.toml:1761-1763: mechanism "none", measure ending `status: not shown`) already passes both tests. So without the spec edit the xtask test still passes. Fix: Say that criterion 1 is shown by the Read of OLY-A-12 and the Grep for `pub fn undecided_surface_changes`. Without the edit the mechanism reads `none` and names no function, which is what fails. Keep the xtask test only as a check that the new text stays well-formed, not as the failing demonstration.

findings.summary: The reason given for rejecting the new-heading comparison overstates its cost; a public helper already does it, and AppendOnly narrows the stated false negative
findings.evidence: `athena_data::decision_links::headings(log)` is public (crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs:100), and athena-core already uses this module (run/checks.rs:26). 'A new entry exists' is `headings(cand).difference(&headings(base)).next().is_some()`, so the function would grow by about two lines, not toward wiring. Separately, the AppendOnly mirror rule (mirrors.rs, cited by the plan) means any change to decisions.md is an append. The real false negative is therefore text appended to D171 or later with no new heading, which is narrower than 'any edit to the log'. Fix: Keep the path rule, since criterion 2 and the accepted reading specify it. Correct the rejection reason in Decision 2 and D172: the follow-up is cheap through `decision_links::headings`. State the narrower limit: an append to the log with no new `## D` heading.
findings.location: Plan, Decision 2 (second rejected alternative) and Risks (path rule)

findings.summary: The refusal_corpus negative at line 1148 is not cited with its twins
findings.evidence: refusal_corpus.rs:1148 also asserts `!changelog.contains("3 of the 3 cited jobs")`; the plan cites only 1229 and 1769-1770. Step 6 already bans that string, so the plan is not affected. Fix: Add line 1148 to the citation.

summary: I checked the plan against the code with Read and Grep only. It is a small, sound fit for the accepted reading. It adds a pure function, `undecided_surface_changes`, built on the existing `diff`, `SurfaceDiff::kinds()` (design_surface.rs:635) and `KindDiff::total()` (608). Its test builds `SurfaceInventory` values directly; that type derives Default and has public BTreeMaps (athena-data records/design_surface.rs:12-28). The measure ends `status: not shown`, which both xtask spec.rs:204-212 and hestia `measure_problem` (hestia.rs:1219-1232) accept. D172 is the right next id (D171 at decisions.md:4944 is the last entry). Keeping run/checks.rs untouched is a fair answer to the earlier round. The criterion 2 test would fail if the body returned nothing, and it uses no double. The verdict is revise because of one major gap: the dependents list leaves out hestia.rs:4285-4294. That test parses the real spec.toml and checks every active requirement's measure, OLY-A-12 included, and step 7's by-name runs do not reach it. Several positive-match CHANGELOG readers are also unlisted. Two minor points: (1) criterion 1's 'fails without' claim is wrong, because the xtask spec test accepts mechanism `none`; (2) the plan says comparing headings would make the function larger, but the public `decision_links::headings` helper makes it about two lines, and the AppendOnly rule narrows the false negative the plan describes. These are small fixes to the plan's text and test list, not to its design.
